sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "city"."County_ID" AS e, "county_public_safety"."Police_force" AS g, AVG((CAST("city"."White" AS REAL) / "city"."Black")) AS m1 FROM "city" JOIN "county_public_safety" ON "county_public_safety"."County_ID" = "city"."County_ID"  GROUP BY "city"."County_ID", "county_public_safety"."Police_force"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s3"."g" = "s4"."g" WHERE "s3"."m2" > "s4"."v"), "s6" AS (SELECT "s5"."g" AS g, AVG("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5" GROUP BY "s5"."g") SELECT AVG("s6"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s6"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s6"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s6"
